files.LA TRIBU TOLTECA _ Mart n El Constructor:
1
00:00:00,120 --> 00:00:02,904
—I am not a man of faith. I, myself, consider myself

2
00:00:02,904 --> 00:00:05,366
a man of deeds, a man of action.

3
00:00:05,366 --> 00:00:09,089
What I think, I do. As we say in Mexico:

4
00:00:09,089 --> 00:00:13,408
"Saying and doing." I prefer experience and not belief.

5
00:00:13,408 --> 00:00:18,173
There is an abysmal difference between believing and living it: the action, the facts.

6
00:00:18,173 --> 00:00:21,317
Don't tell me you love me, show it.

7
00:00:21,317 --> 00:00:25,951
Prove it! That's the action. That is the fact; and without saying anything,

8
00:00:25,951 --> 00:00:29,209
you can say a lot... By doing things.

9
00:00:29,209 --> 00:00:32,960
—I met you from a video in which you talked about Impeccability.

10
00:00:32,960 --> 00:00:34,960
Could you explain to me what Impeccability is?

11
00:00:35,042 --> 00:00:40,141
—To be impeccable is to be of one piece. That means that as you think, you have to live.

12
00:00:40,141 --> 00:00:44,543
As you think, you have to eat. As you think, it has to be your complete life.

13
00:00:44,543 --> 00:00:45,678
It's being true!

14
00:00:45,678 --> 00:00:49,388
Testing is always around the corner. One person claims to be the best walker,

15
00:00:49,388 --> 00:00:51,812
and around the corner you start to limp.

16
00:00:51,812 --> 00:00:57,680
Part of that concept led people to acquire a true face.

17
00:00:57,680 --> 00:00:59,807
And why do I say this? Because, what, we don't have a face?

18
00:00:59,807 --> 00:01:01,663
No! We have masks.

19
00:01:01,663 --> 00:01:05,111
Masks for everything: At home, with friends,

20
00:01:05,111 --> 00:01:08,573
with siblings, with your girlfriend, with work...

21
00:01:08,573 --> 00:01:11,339
But we don't give real faces.

22
00:01:11,339 --> 00:01:15,815
We hide, we keep... So, part of that Impeccability is that:

23
00:01:16,307 --> 00:01:19,831
Acquiring a true face, which also means being a Toltec:

24
00:01:20,627 --> 00:01:23,000
He who dialogues with his own heart.

25
00:01:23,000 --> 00:01:27,659
I believe that any knowledge of the world is available to human beings

26
00:01:27,659 --> 00:01:31,326
for their own transcendence. If not, what's the joke?

27
00:01:31,326 --> 00:01:32,575
So much knowledge?

28
00:01:32,575 --> 00:01:36,000
Just like that, as scholars or as bookworms?

29
00:01:36,000 --> 00:01:37,168
You have to live it!

30
00:01:37,168 --> 00:01:38,418
You have to live it.

31
00:01:38,418 --> 00:01:40,040
You yourself, now that you travel so much, right?

32
00:01:40,040 --> 00:01:44,289
You could read books and books and books and encyclopedias about the places...

33
00:01:44,289 --> 00:01:47,661
How different it is to go to them! No?

34
00:01:47,661 --> 00:01:50,085
And living and being with the people, the road, the jungle,

35
00:01:50,085 --> 00:01:54,000
the cold, the heat, the food... The experience is something else!

36
00:01:54,000 --> 00:01:56,222
And experience, well, it will guide your criteria.

37
00:01:56,222 --> 00:01:57,699
Then it will no longer be a belief!

38
00:01:57,699 --> 00:02:00,000
Now it's going to be experience.

39
00:02:00,000 --> 00:02:02,644
And that is part of the ancient knowledge of Mexico,

40
00:02:02,644 --> 00:02:04,644
Toltec: Impeccability.

41
00:02:04,876 --> 00:02:06,992
Be a man of own experience.

42
00:02:06,992 --> 00:02:09,985
Do not be guided by beliefs or things of faith.

43
00:02:09,985 --> 00:02:13,130
You live it! Experience it. ...And then, we talked.

44
00:02:13,130 --> 00:02:16,913
—Experience is my greatest asset, it is my best capital. That's why I'm here.

45
00:02:16,913 --> 00:02:19,984
—Because that experience is going to go with you.

46
00:02:19,984 --> 00:02:23,467
It will be energetically marked in your being.

47
00:02:23,467 --> 00:02:25,626
It will accompany you wherever you go.

48
00:02:25,626 --> 00:02:29,762
Whether it is or whether other forms of life do not exist,

49
00:02:29,762 --> 00:02:31,126
they will accompany you.

50
00:02:31,126 --> 00:02:34,760
That is part, I believe, of our elements...

51
00:02:34,760 --> 00:02:39,217
Right? ...in this life to be able to be understanding,

52
00:02:39,217 --> 00:02:40,543
To be able to understand.

53
00:02:40,543 --> 00:02:42,735
Because understanding is very difficult, right?

54
00:02:42,735 --> 00:02:47,120
The word sounds easy, "understand," but coming to understand changes your life.

55
00:02:47,120 --> 00:02:49,476
A Mexican poet named Nezahualcóyotl said,

56
00:02:49,476 --> 00:02:52,650
"At last my heart understands:

57
00:02:54,000 --> 00:02:58,209
I hear a song, And I see a flower:

58
00:02:58,209 --> 00:03:01,505
May they not wither! May they not wither!"

59
00:03:01,505 --> 00:03:04,224
He understood that he was going to die.

60
00:03:04,224 --> 00:03:06,575
—"Do we come to live in vain?

61
00:03:06,575 --> 00:03:08,992
To sprout on the Earth? —Mmm, there it is!

62
00:03:08,992 --> 00:03:12,636
Let's at least leave flowers, Let's at least leave songs."

63
00:03:12,636 --> 00:03:14,107
-That's how it is! —It's his, isn't it?

64
00:03:14,107 --> 00:03:16,592
-Is he! "Let us at least leave flowers and at least songs,"

65
00:03:16,592 --> 00:03:21,176
because perhaps, there, on the other side, in the region of mystery,

66
00:03:21,176 --> 00:03:24,819
the flowers will end and the songs will end.

67
00:03:24,819 --> 00:03:26,388
But here, on Earth...

68
00:03:26,388 --> 00:03:27,194
Nobody!

69
00:03:27,487 --> 00:03:29,918
Nobody can put an end to the flowers and the songs.

70
00:03:30,177 --> 00:03:33,120
—I finally understood!

71
00:03:34,724 --> 00:03:36,000
I didn't know that was why.

72
00:03:36,000 --> 00:03:39,023
-You see? Have you seen why? Understanding is difficult,

73
00:03:39,560 --> 00:03:42,849
but when you understand it, something opens in your heart,

74
00:03:42,849 --> 00:03:45,880
in your mind and then something

75
00:03:45,880 --> 00:03:48,292
called: Consciousness begins to arrive.

76
00:03:48,292 --> 00:03:50,065
It's fashionable! Everyone talks about it,

77
00:03:50,065 --> 00:03:51,930
and no one knows what it is!

78
00:03:52,851 --> 00:03:55,563
Everyone takes courses on "Consciousness,"

79
00:03:55,563 --> 00:03:58,897
courses on I don't know what, and they're... Excuse me, they're still the same!

80
00:03:58,897 --> 00:04:01,413
There is more and more "consciousness," and the world, I don't see it changing!

81
00:04:01,413 --> 00:04:02,815
And there is more and more "awareness"!

82
00:04:02,815 --> 00:04:04,894
—With all the "mindfulness" there is, right? ...

83
00:04:04,894 --> 00:04:08,493
—Yes, yes...Therapists, retreats... People with a diploma

84
00:04:08,493 --> 00:04:09,932
who already have "a conscience."

85
00:04:09,932 --> 00:04:13,140
—In other words, "a diploma certifies your conscience." -But? "You are now a shaman."

86
00:04:13,140 --> 00:04:15,519
—Paying. -Yes of course!

87
00:04:15,519 --> 00:04:17,080
It's okay to investigate, it's okay to search,

88
00:04:17,080 --> 00:04:20,797
but that's where Impeccability comes in: you have to make it authentic.

89
00:04:20,797 --> 00:04:22,797
You have to make it true.

90
00:04:22,880 --> 00:04:25,319
Otherwise, it doesn't work! It is nothing more than a fashion,

91
00:04:25,319 --> 00:04:29,600
it is nothing more than a practice that, due to the euphoria of the moment...

92
00:04:29,600 --> 00:04:30,904
And then, it is forgotten!

93
00:04:30,904 --> 00:04:34,920
Because to walk within those paths, a certain discipline is also required.

94
00:04:34,920 --> 00:04:40,011
No? A certain grit, a certain effort... In all aspects.

95
00:04:40,011 --> 00:04:42,932
—I met a grandfather in Colombia who told me:

96
00:04:42,932 --> 00:04:45,925
"You have no choice but to be what you walk."

97
00:04:45,925 --> 00:04:48,880
—And it sounds easy, right? —Ugh, it's very difficult!

98
00:04:48,880 --> 00:04:51,502
—But point number one: You have to admit it.

99
00:04:51,502 --> 00:04:53,242
—At least, see it. —That which you are that you walk...

100
00:04:53,242 --> 00:04:55,254
Or at least, that which you think you are!

101
00:04:56,759 --> 00:04:58,308
—Which then changes and mutates over time.

102
00:04:58,308 --> 00:04:59,179
—Of course, that's why I'm telling you!

103
00:04:59,179 --> 00:05:02,182
Sometimes we are not even what we thought we were.

104
00:05:02,599 --> 00:05:06,160
So recognition, right? Day to day: You have to live!

105
00:05:06,160 --> 00:05:09,453
And every second counts, you have to live it. We're going away!

106
00:05:09,453 --> 00:05:12,560
You have to leave something, you have to share.

107
00:05:12,560 --> 00:05:17,259
Because what else can we leave? Well, our knowledge, our energy...

108
00:05:17,259 --> 00:05:18,960
Gap, for others who come behind.

109
00:05:18,960 --> 00:05:24,000
Life, as life, contains a principle of reciprocity.

110
00:05:24,000 --> 00:05:25,560
One has to contribute too.

111
00:05:25,560 --> 00:05:28,704
It's a way to honor her. She honors us,

112
00:05:28,704 --> 00:05:30,977
Giving us everything... And what do we give her?

113
00:05:30,977 --> 00:05:32,522
Pure poop!

114
00:05:33,052 --> 00:05:34,522
Every day.

115
00:05:34,522 --> 00:05:37,342
I mean, it sounds stinky and it sounds ugly, and maybe what I say is even grotesque,

116
00:05:37,342 --> 00:05:39,880
but it's the truth!

117
00:05:39,880 --> 00:05:42,666
It's the truth! And anyone who says they don't poop is not human.

118
00:05:42,666 --> 00:05:44,560
—If it were good poop... —Right?

119
00:05:44,560 --> 00:05:47,456
What are we doing? What are we then, then?

120
00:05:47,456 --> 00:05:49,229
A plague?

121
00:05:49,229 --> 00:05:50,575
A bundle of meat and bones?

122
00:05:51,131 --> 00:05:52,760
No, surely not!

123
00:05:52,760 --> 00:05:56,746
It is time to shake off, to dust off certain ideas,

124
00:05:56,746 --> 00:06:00,686
certain schemes that have been imposed for hundreds of years,

125
00:06:00,686 --> 00:06:02,376
that lead us nowhere.

126
00:06:02,376 --> 00:06:05,619
I am not inviting a revolution, or a war...

127
00:06:05,619 --> 00:06:07,874
But, maybe yes, a war. But to an internal war.

128
00:06:08,404 --> 00:06:09,874
To an internal war. TRUE?

129
00:06:09,920 --> 00:06:12,593
Which is the most difficult, the most difficult to get rid of.

130
00:06:12,593 --> 00:06:14,593
That's why here it was called, aptly,

131
00:06:14,593 --> 00:06:18,000
the Florida War: The fight with yourself.

132
00:06:18,000 --> 00:06:21,278
The defeat of your ego, or of your enemy within you.

133
00:06:21,278 --> 00:06:25,364
So that, once you manage to overcome that internal part,

134
00:06:25,591 --> 00:06:29,486
Your heart will flourish; your face becomes true.

135
00:06:29,486 --> 00:06:31,530
You won the Florida War!

136
00:06:31,530 --> 00:06:33,682
And how wonderful it is to understand

137
00:06:33,682 --> 00:06:36,864
that, like a gear in a clock,

138
00:06:36,864 --> 00:06:39,463
an ant, an animal, a plant, a human being

139
00:06:39,463 --> 00:06:41,744
are part of that gear.

140
00:06:41,744 --> 00:06:45,335
Therefore, it has a purpose, it has a function...

141
00:06:45,335 --> 00:06:49,265
Even like the hummingbird, right now, which came to confirm for us, to reaffirm

142
00:06:49,265 --> 00:06:51,251
what we were going to start talking about right now, right?

143
00:06:51,251 --> 00:06:53,042
—What have you learned on the Way of the Warrior?

144
00:06:53,042 --> 00:06:54,960
—To be me, to be me. To be me, as is.

145
00:06:54,960 --> 00:06:59,418
Physically, mentally, spiritually, right? And I accept myself and love myself just the way I am:

146
00:06:59,418 --> 00:07:01,880
short, long hair, dark...

147
00:07:01,880 --> 00:07:05,818
And I like, apart from that, the word "flowery." And I also learned this on the way,

148
00:07:06,538 --> 00:07:08,576
Because the word is sacred.

149
00:07:08,576 --> 00:07:11,281
—This same grandfather I was telling you about before told me:

150
00:07:11,281 --> 00:07:14,501
"Take care of your word, your word will take care of you."

151
00:07:14,501 --> 00:07:16,898
-Well yes. Because if not, that's why I say, you make a mess of yourself.

152
00:07:16,898 --> 00:07:20,421
You make an offense, because another one will come later.

153
00:07:20,421 --> 00:07:23,737
You take care of your word, on the contrary, right?

154
00:07:23,737 --> 00:07:27,306
—And on this path of Impeccability, when we err, what happens there?

155
00:07:27,306 --> 00:07:29,306
—We have to try again because, look:

156
00:07:29,306 --> 00:07:32,989
We have to learn to walk above triumphs and defeats.

157
00:07:32,989 --> 00:07:36,668
One of the premises we have been taught, or schemes,

158
00:07:36,668 --> 00:07:39,198
is that "Everything is a success or everything is a failure."

159
00:07:39,198 --> 00:07:41,495
"Everything is a blessing or everything is a curse."

160
00:07:41,495 --> 00:07:43,200
That's silly!

161
00:07:43,200 --> 00:07:47,424
Because as you walk on the path of life, which is full of networks and holes,

162
00:07:47,424 --> 00:07:49,424
you will surely fall into some.

163
00:07:49,886 --> 00:07:54,952
But greatness is standing up. It is not not falling, but getting up.

164
00:07:54,952 --> 00:07:58,224
So, you have to learn to walk through this world

165
00:07:58,224 --> 00:08:00,224
above triumphs and defeats.

166
00:08:00,224 --> 00:08:03,818
Because everything in life is neither a triumph nor a defeat,

167
00:08:03,818 --> 00:08:05,788
nor is it a curse, nor is it a blessing.

168
00:08:05,788 --> 00:08:07,860
Really, everything is a challenge.

169
00:08:07,860 --> 00:08:10,133
On the same motorcycle that you ride, right?

170
00:08:10,133 --> 00:08:14,187
You skid, you fall... Well, you get up and continue! No?

171
00:08:14,187 --> 00:08:16,700
I don't retreat, I continue. No? Anyway, that's life.

172
00:08:16,700 --> 00:08:19,541
In life there can be no line of happiness.

173
00:08:19,541 --> 00:08:23,173
Because that line of happiness, for me, is even boring.

174
00:08:23,173 --> 00:08:24,840
It's boring! It's everyday.

175
00:08:24,840 --> 00:08:26,694
It's about habits! No, it can not be!

176
00:08:26,694 --> 00:08:29,376
The world is changing, and you have to adapt.

177
00:08:29,376 --> 00:08:31,376
Today you are here; tomorrow you won't be there.

178
00:08:31,619 --> 00:08:34,751
Today you will be happy, today your stew turned out well; not tomorrow.

179
00:08:34,751 --> 00:08:36,560
Projects are like that too, right?

180
00:08:36,560 --> 00:08:40,089
Sometimes you work harder, sometimes you work... There can't be a line.

181
00:08:40,089 --> 00:08:42,089
It would be very boring.

182
00:08:42,173 --> 00:08:46,994
—It seems that there is a certain taboo regarding being sad or feeling bad.

183
00:08:46,994 --> 00:08:51,722
It's like society rewards being good: "It's nice to be good!",

184
00:08:51,722 --> 00:08:55,189
but rather condemns being bad: "Oops! Why would it be bad?"

185
00:08:55,189 --> 00:08:58,485
—But even the one who is apparently happy is not well.

186
00:08:58,485 --> 00:09:01,364
Because it's a mask, because inside they are crying.

187
00:09:01,364 --> 00:09:04,234
Inside they are sad... We are human!

188
00:09:04,234 --> 00:09:09,273
We feel cold, we feel heat, we feel joy, we have longings...

189
00:09:09,273 --> 00:09:12,994
We cannot lie; We can't say no.

190
00:09:12,994 --> 00:09:14,585
For example, they greet me, they say, "How are you?"

191
00:09:14,585 --> 00:09:16,560
"Well happy," Because I try to be happy.

192
00:09:16,560 --> 00:09:18,000
Even though whatever happens.

193
00:09:18,000 --> 00:09:21,308
But I don't like to complain. That's different, isn't it?

194
00:09:21,308 --> 00:09:23,695
"Oh, this happens to me, that happens to me," and I start cursing...

195
00:09:23,695 --> 00:09:25,826
No! Well, it's going to be resolved somehow.

196
00:09:25,826 --> 00:09:28,440
The only thing that cannot be resolved is death; and who knows?

197
00:09:28,440 --> 00:09:30,477
Maybe it's an alternative...

198
00:09:30,477 --> 00:09:31,079
—and the Treasury.

199
00:09:31,079 --> 00:09:32,488
-Ah yeah sure.

200
00:09:32,488 --> 00:09:34,042
—Groucho Marx said it:

201
00:09:34,042 --> 00:09:37,140
"The only thing that has no solution in life is death and the Treasury."

202
00:09:37,140 --> 00:09:41,400
—But, some of us are insurgents and we don't pay the Treasury!

203
00:09:41,400 --> 00:09:43,761
So, you have to live however life comes, right?

204
00:09:43,761 --> 00:09:48,800
Happy, sad... Because, well, there is everything, right?

205
00:09:48,800 --> 00:09:52,470
There is everything, and that's how it is! And that's what makes her rich.

206
00:09:52,470 --> 00:09:54,213
The experience is rich for that reason.

207
00:09:54,213 --> 00:09:55,235
—What does wealth mean to you?

208
00:09:55,235 --> 00:09:57,796
—Well, wealth for me is the accumulation of experiences.

209
00:09:57,796 --> 00:10:00,334
Knowledge, level of understanding.

210
00:10:00,334 --> 00:10:04,948
Truly, if I died and was born again, I would take the same path.

211
00:10:04,948 --> 00:10:07,911
I have loved the path of the Warrior,

212
00:10:07,911 --> 00:10:09,911
the path of Knowledge, the path of my culture.

213
00:10:10,449 --> 00:10:12,542
So, wealth for me is that, right?

214
00:10:12,542 --> 00:10:15,914
The power to understand, the power to understand, the power to know.

215
00:10:15,914 --> 00:10:19,543
Because there are things that material wealth cannot buy,

216
00:10:19,543 --> 00:10:23,360
and one of them is health: mental health, spiritual health.

217
00:10:23,360 --> 00:10:28,213
There are people who are in spiritual holes or in spiritual misery...

218
00:10:28,895 --> 00:10:30,630
Not just economic.

219
00:10:30,630 --> 00:10:33,316
But if you are rich spiritually,

220
00:10:33,316 --> 00:10:35,241
you are going to be rich economically, automatically,

221
00:10:35,241 --> 00:10:38,734
because you are going to have the drive and the drive to do things,

222
00:10:38,734 --> 00:10:41,625
and one way or another, you are going to solve it.

223
00:10:41,625 --> 00:10:42,835
There is a song that says:

224
00:10:42,835 --> 00:10:45,934
"Every day the bird seeks its nest again."

225
00:10:45,934 --> 00:10:50,396
What are you worried about, my brother?

226
00:10:50,396 --> 00:10:54,000
—...Yes, every day the bird has to look for a place to sleep, brother!

227
00:10:55,578 --> 00:10:57,512
When you find your enemy,

228
00:10:57,512 --> 00:11:00,189
which as I understood you, is yourself,

229
00:11:00,189 --> 00:11:01,126
what do you do?

230
00:11:01,126 --> 00:11:04,840
—First you have to know it, you have to identify it.

231
00:11:04,840 --> 00:11:07,762
I'm starting to think, right? And in that thinking,

232
00:11:07,762 --> 00:11:10,680
I see what emotion that thought produces in me,

233
00:11:10,680 --> 00:11:13,245
or what feeling that thought produces in me...

234
00:11:13,245 --> 00:11:15,245
How is my body feeling? How does my heart beat?

235
00:11:15,245 --> 00:11:16,200
Or my liver, right?

236
00:11:16,200 --> 00:11:18,891
And then, there I realize, I begin to realize

237
00:11:18,891 --> 00:11:21,240
the things that affect me or that do not affect me,

238
00:11:21,240 --> 00:11:23,256
or even my own vices:

239
00:11:23,256 --> 00:11:25,256
What do I want more? What do I want less?

240
00:11:25,256 --> 00:11:27,120
What do I long for more? What do I long for less?

241
00:11:27,120 --> 00:11:30,000
In that simplicity, I began to realize

242
00:11:30,000 --> 00:11:34,000
what my strengths were, what my weaknesses were...

243
00:11:34,000 --> 00:11:37,506
But real, real, real, real... And in the simplest way you can.

244
00:11:37,506 --> 00:11:39,400
But you have to be honest.

245
00:11:39,400 --> 00:11:42,000
You have to be very honest! And we are generally not honest.

246
00:11:42,000 --> 00:11:43,262
We deceive ourselves very easily,

247
00:11:43,262 --> 00:11:46,254
or we give reasons for things.

248
00:11:46,254 --> 00:11:49,316
One has to undress completely to see oneself.

249
00:11:49,316 --> 00:11:52,167
So literally, like naked in a mirror

250
00:11:52,167 --> 00:11:56,310
to see what you are like, what you have... What you are.

251
00:11:56,310 --> 00:12:00,288
I say, there is no one method for everyone. It's personal!

252
00:12:00,288 --> 00:12:01,738
It's very personal!

253
00:12:01,738 --> 00:12:04,799
Like spiritual discoveries, they are very personal.

254
00:12:04,799 --> 00:12:06,814
The calls are very personal.

255
00:12:06,814 --> 00:12:10,334
So the method? Well I say, Invent it yourself!

256
00:12:10,334 --> 00:12:12,227
You are the only one who knows how you are.

257
00:12:12,227 --> 00:12:15,651
Not even the best therapist is going to give you the solution.

258
00:12:15,651 --> 00:12:18,000
Maybe He will give you a path, but you walk the path.

259
00:12:18,000 --> 00:12:22,516
And so, you realize that maybe, suddenly you have a possibility,

260
00:12:22,516 --> 00:12:24,000
a talent...

261
00:12:24,000 --> 00:12:26,229
Or even a virtue!

262
00:12:26,229 --> 00:12:28,703
But then comes the other part, which is part of the fight:

263
00:12:28,703 --> 00:12:30,370
Now, exercise it!

264
00:12:30,370 --> 00:12:32,903
Now exercise it! Do not hesitate!

265
00:12:32,903 --> 00:12:36,426
We are full of doubts; We are full of fears.

266
00:12:36,426 --> 00:12:38,704
Because since we were children, we acquired them.

267
00:12:38,704 --> 00:12:42,000
We are surely born free, without fear and without doubts.

268
00:12:42,000 --> 00:12:49,003
But the education of everything around you shapes you.

269
00:12:49,003 --> 00:12:51,640
And when you least see, you are already the same as everyone:

270
00:12:51,640 --> 00:12:54,401
You suffer from everything, you want what everyone does,

271
00:12:54,401 --> 00:12:57,292
you think what everyone does, you wear what everyone does, and you eat what everyone does.

272
00:12:57,583 --> 00:13:00,000
Well I say, That's called colonization!

273
00:13:00,000 --> 00:13:02,000
—In force today, eh? —In force today.

274
00:13:02,000 --> 00:13:05,160
You have to break those things because, what is at stake?

275
00:13:05,160 --> 00:13:07,679
Well, our own lives are at stake!

276
00:13:07,679 --> 00:13:10,615
And it really is difficult to understand.

277
00:13:10,615 --> 00:13:13,115
It is understood, perhaps, mentally:

278
00:13:13,172 --> 00:13:15,472
"Ah, you're just going to be here temporarily",

279
00:13:15,472 --> 00:13:17,101
"Oh no, I mean... we're all going to die",

280
00:13:17,101 --> 00:13:18,622
"Ah, it's true: We're going to die". everyone"

281
00:13:18,622 --> 00:13:22,099
But did you already understand it? Do you really understand it already?

282
00:13:22,099 --> 00:13:26,026
So, get to it now! Because tomorrow may not come.

283
00:13:26,026 --> 00:13:27,167
—But, understanding that...

284
00:13:27,167 --> 00:13:29,533
—That's why I tell you: Understanding, isn't it difficult?

285
00:13:29,533 --> 00:13:30,670
It is not so simple?

286
00:13:30,670 --> 00:13:33,541
You have to move inner keyboards,

287
00:13:33,541 --> 00:13:37,784
certain fibers inside us, for something to move...

288
00:13:37,784 --> 00:13:39,895
And then you say, "Yes, you're right."

289
00:13:39,895 --> 00:13:42,557
—It is difficult to understand something and remain impassive.

290
00:13:42,557 --> 00:13:43,496
-It can't be done.

291
00:13:43,496 --> 00:13:46,489
That's why I tell you: That brings you awareness, to understanding.

292
00:13:46,489 --> 00:13:48,718
And if consciousness comes into your life, I am certain

293
00:13:48,718 --> 00:13:50,718
that it changes from one day to the next.

294
00:13:50,840 --> 00:13:53,501
You can't stay static: You already realized it,

295
00:13:53,501 --> 00:13:55,698
and then you say: "Time does count!

296
00:13:55,698 --> 00:13:58,683
Time has to do with it! No, hurry up, we have little left!"

297
00:13:58,683 --> 00:14:01,382
Because eternal, like this, in this way,

298
00:14:01,382 --> 00:14:03,382
We are not going to be.

299
00:14:03,920 --> 00:14:06,155
We're going to have to go.

300
00:14:06,698 --> 00:14:10,043
Sooner or later, we're going to have to go.

301
00:14:10,043 --> 00:14:14,051
So... There's no need to waste time anymore.

302
00:14:14,793 --> 00:14:16,363
—Are you afraid of having to leave?

303
00:14:16,363 --> 00:14:17,758
-No.

304
00:14:17,758 --> 00:14:19,758
No, it doesn't scare me. I'm not afraid.

305
00:14:20,220 --> 00:14:23,378
I could be uncertain... A little bit, nothing more,

306
00:14:23,378 --> 00:14:25,793
about what could be on the other side, or what's next...

307
00:14:25,793 --> 00:14:27,280
But not afraid.

308
00:14:27,280 --> 00:14:31,192
No fear. What's more, we in Mexico have a saying that goes like this:

309
00:14:31,192 --> 00:14:34,334
"If I have to die tomorrow, let me die once and for all."

310
00:14:34,334 --> 00:14:38,218
Preparing to live is preparing to die.

311
00:14:38,218 --> 00:14:40,218
It seems paradoxical, right?

312
00:14:40,710 --> 00:14:41,666
But it is.

313
00:14:41,666 --> 00:14:43,940
It is! It's something that goes hand in hand.

314
00:14:43,940 --> 00:14:44,876
—Is everything dual?

315
00:14:44,876 --> 00:14:46,572
-Mostly, yes.

316
00:14:46,572 --> 00:14:49,565
But that duality also has a unity.

317
00:14:49,565 --> 00:14:51,725
Ourselves: you have two hands,

318
00:14:51,725 --> 00:14:53,725
two feet, two hemispheres, two eyes...

319
00:14:53,725 --> 00:14:55,982
two nostrils,

320
00:14:56,120 --> 00:14:58,504
two ears... But you are one.

321
00:14:58,504 --> 00:15:02,084
Duality, I think, contains a complexity.

322
00:15:02,084 --> 00:15:04,680
And that complexity, well, it is also a duality.

323
00:15:04,680 --> 00:15:06,971
And it's a plurality, right?

324
00:15:06,971 --> 00:15:10,040
Nothing but everything is taught to us strictly, bluntly,

325
00:15:10,040 --> 00:15:13,963
without stickers, without media: "Either it's white, or it's black."

326
00:15:13,963 --> 00:15:17,297
But between white and black, there is a variety of colors,

327
00:15:17,297 --> 00:15:20,175
of intensities, right? That is what has not been understood.

328
00:15:20,175 --> 00:15:23,357
And it is also what they have misunderstood about Mexican culture,

329
00:15:23,357 --> 00:15:25,918
because Mexican culture talks a lot about duality.

330
00:15:25,918 --> 00:15:29,479
We have no problem understanding the plurality of things,

331
00:15:29,479 --> 00:15:33,179
because the Spirit itself is a diversity of things.

332
00:15:33,179 --> 00:15:35,251
It is an incredible plurality.

333
00:15:35,251 --> 00:15:41,055
And thanks to that plurality, the world exists with all its diversities.

334
00:15:41,055 --> 00:15:44,255
Not only of geographies, but of human beings.

335
00:15:44,255 --> 00:15:46,255
The worldview of Mexico speaks of all that,

336
00:15:46,377 --> 00:15:49,408
of a principle, yes, an abstract principle,

337
00:15:49,408 --> 00:15:54,196
an invisible principle, an impalpable principle, a spark of light.

338
00:15:54,196 --> 00:15:56,137
In Mexico it is called Moyocoyani

339
00:15:56,137 --> 00:15:59,842
and means "He who invents himself and transforms himself."

340
00:16:00,418 --> 00:16:05,510
And that impersonal force, by its own virtue or its own power, unfolded.

341
00:16:05,510 --> 00:16:08,797
And he became an androgynous being, and Ometeotl was born.

342
00:16:08,797 --> 00:16:11,002
And the androgynous is divided in two,

343
00:16:11,002 --> 00:16:12,964
and the man and the woman are born: The dual.

344
00:16:12,964 --> 00:16:18,000
And then the dual creates four children, right? And those four children create four more.

345
00:16:18,000 --> 00:16:22,950
And so it begins, from a unity, to be a duality and then a plurality...

346
00:16:22,950 --> 00:16:24,950
But in the totality of space.

347
00:16:25,640 --> 00:16:29,380
In such a way that the creation of life, from the Mexican angle,

348
00:16:29,380 --> 00:16:31,380
is not created through one element,

349
00:16:31,380 --> 00:16:34,363
but is created through many conjugates...

350
00:16:34,363 --> 00:16:37,920
And then, all those elements can be mixed with each other,

351
00:16:37,920 --> 00:16:40,940
and create something new. And many essences...

352
00:16:40,940 --> 00:16:42,940
But they all come from a beginning.

353
00:16:43,440 --> 00:16:46,062
That is why it is said that everything is sacred and everything is divine,

354
00:16:46,062 --> 00:16:50,828
because that plural divine principle was unfolded in all things.

355
00:16:50,828 --> 00:16:54,501
And one, as an individual, one has to return a little bit

356
00:16:54,501 --> 00:16:56,917
of that honor and that energy, that essence,

357
00:16:56,917 --> 00:16:59,418
because it is so divided that it could die.

358
00:16:59,418 --> 00:17:03,653
Because the plural divine essence is present in all things.

359
00:17:03,653 --> 00:17:09,880
Everything is divine: the wood, the river, the lake, you, your dog, the bird,

360
00:17:09,880 --> 00:17:13,284
the hummingbird, the cloud, the star...

361
00:17:13,284 --> 00:17:16,610
Because everything is captured there. We are all brothers.

362
00:17:18,360 --> 00:17:20,837
As human beings, I say, we are all equal, right?

363
00:17:20,837 --> 00:17:23,413
We have the right to life, the right to eat,

364
00:17:23,413 --> 00:17:28,350
the right to breathe, to think, to live, to have a home... Whatever you want, right?

365
00:17:28,350 --> 00:17:30,983
But the difference is what we keep in our hearts.

366
00:17:30,983 --> 00:17:33,779
So there, we are already different.

367
00:17:34,658 --> 00:17:39,459
Because some keep beautiful things, and some keep very ugly things.

368
00:17:39,459 --> 00:17:41,431
There is a story that says

369
00:17:41,431 --> 00:17:46,280
that before, human beings were telepathic. I didn't even need the Internet.

370
00:17:46,280 --> 00:17:49,472
But as he kept things in his mind and in his heart,

371
00:17:49,472 --> 00:17:52,654
his heart began to close and so did his mind,

372
00:17:52,654 --> 00:17:56,070
and he began to stalk, to long for what was not his.

373
00:17:56,070 --> 00:17:58,881
So it was closing, it was saving, hiding...

374
00:17:58,881 --> 00:18:01,927
Because you could see the other's mind, the other's heart.

375
00:18:01,927 --> 00:18:06,000
As we closed it, the mind closed and the heart closed...

376
00:18:06,000 --> 00:18:07,526
Because we keep things.

377
00:18:07,526 --> 00:18:10,951
So, there's the difference. We are no longer equal.

378
00:18:10,951 --> 00:18:14,032
That is why it is so important to give a true face.

379
00:18:14,032 --> 00:18:16,040
Always a face. The same!

380
00:18:16,040 --> 00:18:18,485
It is very difficult. It's not that easy.

381
00:18:18,485 --> 00:18:19,803
—It is accepting yourself in everything.

382
00:18:19,803 --> 00:18:22,880
—And accept things as they are, too. Because above all, we give a mask:

383
00:18:22,880 --> 00:18:26,588
If you are upset, if you don't like something, if you don't like someone...

384
00:18:26,588 --> 00:18:29,505
You give a mask; You don't show yourself as you are.

385
00:18:29,505 --> 00:18:32,555
By protocols, right? Or by customs, right?

386
00:18:32,555 --> 00:18:33,623
—Social uses.

387
00:18:33,653 --> 00:18:35,477
—Exactly, for social uses.

388
00:18:35,477 --> 00:18:40,440
But for that reason, the person who is sincere, sometimes falls very well, or sometimes falls very badly.

389
00:18:40,440 --> 00:18:41,825
I prefer to be honest.

390
00:18:41,825 --> 00:18:45,727
Even if I fall badly, I don't care. I am not guided by conventions.

391
00:18:45,727 --> 00:18:48,209
I am as I am, and it's over... Period!

392
00:18:48,209 --> 00:18:53,503
Because it is a way, also, to express yourself, what you think, right?

393
00:18:53,503 --> 00:18:59,165
With that, I don't mean that I'm in a position to bother or attack someone.

394
00:18:59,165 --> 00:19:01,589
No, I only say what I think. Nothing else.

395
00:19:01,589 --> 00:19:05,592
—Yes, without your opinion being modulated by possible reactions.

396
00:19:05,592 --> 00:19:06,880
—Of course, yes, yes, yes!

397
00:19:06,880 --> 00:19:09,188
And also, if anyone is interested in my opinion, then let them take it.

398
00:19:09,188 --> 00:19:11,840
If not, then throw it away... I don't care either.

399
00:19:11,840 --> 00:19:15,346
Because I live and think based on a life; to a way of life

400
00:19:15,346 --> 00:19:18,952
and to some convictions... And I'm going on them.

401
00:19:18,952 --> 00:19:21,699
And if I don't live like that, then what am I?

402
00:19:21,699 --> 00:19:24,000
—A puppet. -TRUE?

403
00:19:24,291 --> 00:19:27,448
Well, I prefer to guide my life:

404
00:19:27,940 --> 00:19:29,418
Be the guide of my life.

405
00:19:29,418 --> 00:19:31,809
You could even say that the guide of my destiny.

406
00:19:31,809 --> 00:19:35,514
—Which native civilization here have you learned the most from? From the Toltec?

407
00:19:35,514 --> 00:19:37,042
—From the Toltec and the Nahuatl.

408
00:19:37,042 --> 00:19:41,315
In some way, it begins to open my eyes and I begin to turn to Mexico,

409
00:19:41,315 --> 00:19:44,440
but I begin to see it with the eyes of the inside, that is, with the eyes of Mexico.

410
00:19:44,440 --> 00:19:46,614
Not seeing Mexico with foreign eyes,

411
00:19:46,614 --> 00:19:48,614
but with insider eyes.

412
00:19:48,614 --> 00:19:50,607
How all people have to see themselves:

413
00:19:50,607 --> 00:19:53,656
With their own eyes. And so I began to discover,

414
00:19:53,656 --> 00:19:55,437
to find...

415
00:19:55,437 --> 00:19:59,634
And it was such a beautiful arrangement, that to this day I am in love.

416
00:19:59,634 --> 00:20:05,061
I am in love with Mexican culture... And in fact, with all the cultures of this continent

417
00:20:05,061 --> 00:20:07,226
and with everything that is authentic in the world, right?

418
00:20:07,226 --> 00:20:09,126
In the end I think we are looking for the same thing.

419
00:20:09,846 --> 00:20:13,751
We want the same; We long for the same.

420
00:20:13,751 --> 00:20:16,918
The same thing, in a thousand different ways.

421
00:20:17,120 --> 00:20:18,875
Life is a very beautiful experience.

422
00:20:18,875 --> 00:20:22,368
... Son! Anyone who can't understand it or understand it a little bit...

423
00:20:22,368 --> 00:20:28,937
will even be a hunchback. But, Son, how nice it is to be here! Seriously, how beautiful!

424
00:20:28,937 --> 00:20:35,567
Eat, share, understand, breathe, get on the motorcycle...

425
00:20:35,567 --> 00:20:43,077
See a beautiful sunrise, a good party; then you retreat to your fast to go to the mystical...

426
00:20:43,077 --> 00:20:44,960
How beautiful!

427
00:20:44,960 --> 00:20:47,780
I see that the human being is one of the few beings on planet Earth

428
00:20:47,780 --> 00:20:49,780
that has that capacity for projection.

429
00:20:50,129 --> 00:20:52,599
From projecting inward and projecting outward...

430
00:20:52,599 --> 00:20:53,508
How wonderful!

431
00:20:53,508 --> 00:20:55,781
—What a shame to pass by and not realize it, right?

432
00:20:55,781 --> 00:20:58,182
—There are people who say: "No, this one passed by like a little animal."

433
00:20:58,182 --> 00:21:00,000
No, no, no... worse than an animal!

434
00:21:00,000 --> 00:21:01,920
Because the animal fulfills its function.

435
00:21:01,920 --> 00:21:05,116
They are not speculating what they are going to do, or what they are not going to do.

436
00:21:05,116 --> 00:21:06,851
They fulfill their function.

437
00:21:06,973 --> 00:21:10,122
They behave like what they are... And us?

438
00:21:10,122 --> 00:21:15,880
In our intellect, in our wisdom, in our superiority...

439
00:21:15,880 --> 00:21:19,055
We are further away from ourselves than animals.

440
00:21:19,055 --> 00:21:21,055
What a shame, right? What a pity!

441
00:21:21,215 --> 00:21:24,000
Sometimes, the world hurts me...

442
00:21:25,137 --> 00:21:26,274
The Earth hurts me.

443
00:21:26,274 --> 00:21:28,304
Because you realize things.

444
00:21:29,537 --> 00:21:33,830
Sometimes you want to shout at them, or open them... Kick them up!

445
00:21:33,830 --> 00:21:38,225
To the kicks in the head or in the skin, so that they give...

446
00:21:38,225 --> 00:21:41,441
But, no! They are called personal.

447
00:21:41,441 --> 00:21:44,624
That's why I said: War is personal; Death is personal.

448
00:21:45,040 --> 00:21:46,932
Awakening is personal...

449
00:21:46,932 --> 00:21:51,474
Whoever wants it, well, there it is! Who doesn't...can't be forced either!

450
00:21:51,474 --> 00:21:53,554
But it should be an obligation...

451
00:21:53,554 --> 00:21:57,001
National or spiritual, or global or universal.

452
00:21:57,001 --> 00:22:01,539
Because the more we do it, I believe, we take weight off the world.

453
00:22:01,539 --> 00:22:06,000
It has too much weight already.

454
00:22:06,000 --> 00:22:07,703
Not just with the environmental and physical destruction, right?

455
00:22:07,703 --> 00:22:10,102
With the destruction of thought:

456
00:22:10,102 --> 00:22:15,330
So much that we carry in our heads, in our hearts, in our feelings...

457
00:22:15,330 --> 00:22:18,529
How much weight!

458
00:22:18,529 --> 00:22:23,067
Full of sentimentality, full of tragedies, full of suffering...

459
00:22:23,067 --> 00:22:27,145
Oh, and full of noise! The world is full of external and internal noise.

460
00:22:27,145 --> 00:22:29,408
There are no more pauses, there are no more silences.

461
00:22:29,408 --> 00:22:33,840
There is no longer a retreat from getting a little bit away from that noise, right?

462
00:22:33,840 --> 00:22:35,178
From the noise!

463
00:22:35,178 --> 00:22:38,049
To stay a little to see the mountain from afar,

464
00:22:38,049 --> 00:22:41,505
to see the people from afar... to love them even more!

465
00:22:41,505 --> 00:22:44,337
Because being there, one sometimes fails to see

466
00:22:44,337 --> 00:22:49,376
the greatness of people, things, people... of the world itself.

467
00:22:49,376 --> 00:22:55,960
When you move away a little bit, you see it from a distance. You say: "No, it's worth it. I'm coming back.

468
00:22:55,960 --> 00:23:00,000
I wanted a meteor to fall on the world... But, better not!"

469
00:23:01,172 --> 00:23:06,508
—Yes, it is difficult to deal with the sensations derived from seeing what is happening,

470
00:23:06,508 --> 00:23:08,639
what the path to the solution could be,

471
00:23:08,639 --> 00:23:10,639
and seeing ourselves so far from it, right? As a collective.

472
00:23:10,950 --> 00:23:12,000
—Yes, yes...

473
00:23:12,000 --> 00:23:13,299
Life

474
00:23:13,299 --> 00:23:15,602
has its own evolutionary process.

475
00:23:15,913 --> 00:23:19,085
And with or without me, life will continue to move forward.

476
00:23:19,085 --> 00:23:22,909
What's more, I'm going to die and the sun is going to continue rising;

477
00:23:22,909 --> 00:23:25,553
The birds are going to continue singing...

478
00:23:25,553 --> 00:23:28,960
But I know that things, due to the evolutionary process of life,

479
00:23:28,960 --> 00:23:31,245
sooner or later, are going to fall into place...

480
00:23:31,245 --> 00:23:34,116
Or have to change. Sooner or later!

481
00:23:34,116 --> 00:23:35,640
They are processes.

482
00:23:35,640 --> 00:23:38,955
Our life, as a personal life, or even as a society,

483
00:23:38,955 --> 00:23:40,167
Or as humanity...

484
00:23:40,167 --> 00:23:45,698
If one were to compare it in the process of evolution of life and time...

485
00:23:45,698 --> 00:23:48,185
It is nothing...

486
00:23:48,185 --> 00:23:50,791
It is nothing! A thousand years, two thousand, three thousand years...

487
00:23:50,791 --> 00:23:52,200
In life, they are nothing!

488
00:23:52,200 --> 00:23:55,083
So, what am I in life? Nothing!

489
00:23:55,083 --> 00:23:57,083
Something tiny!

490
00:23:57,083 --> 00:23:59,655
But also, as a certainty,

491
00:23:59,655 --> 00:24:03,818
that from one's perspective, one has to do something for life.

492
00:24:03,818 --> 00:24:06,394
Contribute with a grain of sand.

493
00:24:06,394 --> 00:24:09,435
It doesn't matter if they know it, if they don't know it,

494
00:24:09,435 --> 00:24:11,291
if they understand it or if they don't understand it.

495
00:24:11,291 --> 00:24:14,433
One understands it, one knows it; and you know why he does it.

496
00:24:14,433 --> 00:24:18,251
And if we all thought like that, many cells would come together.

497
00:24:18,251 --> 00:24:21,593
And maybe a process would be faster.

498
00:24:21,593 --> 00:24:24,881
So what's left? Live according to your convictions.

499
00:24:24,881 --> 00:24:27,040
The world is going to continue moving forward.

500
00:24:27,040 --> 00:24:31,445
We will no longer be here, but you lived according to your convictions

501
00:24:31,445 --> 00:24:33,445
for the time you had to live.

502
00:24:33,680 --> 00:24:36,218
And for me, that is the most complete satisfaction

503
00:24:36,218 --> 00:24:41,181
because I know that from the trenches that I am in, with a little or a lot,

504
00:24:41,181 --> 00:24:44,557
I am contributing. Maybe I helped someone,

505
00:24:44,557 --> 00:24:48,565
woke someone up, we shared something, he understood.

506
00:24:48,565 --> 00:24:50,615
Well, what else can you do?

507
00:24:50,615 --> 00:24:53,126
We are not in a position of power to move

508
00:24:53,126 --> 00:24:55,492
the levers of the world and change things.

509
00:24:55,492 --> 00:24:57,947
We are not! We are ordinary men.

510
00:24:57,947 --> 00:25:00,833
But within our ordinariness,

511
00:25:00,833 --> 00:25:04,042
we can change our ordinariness, personally.

512
00:25:04,042 --> 00:25:09,452
And if you change personally and live like that, in that strong way,

513
00:25:09,452 --> 00:25:11,452
you will surely move someone.

514
00:25:11,763 --> 00:25:15,263
He's going to see you! And even if he doesn't tell you, you are going to be his example.

515
00:25:15,263 --> 00:25:17,731
You are going to be their reference.

516
00:25:17,731 --> 00:25:20,038
And it is a way to transcend too.

517
00:25:20,038 --> 00:25:21,785
You have to live according to your convictions,

518
00:25:21,785 --> 00:25:26,960
because that will give you the certainty of being you... Even if others don't understand it and don't know it!

519
00:25:26,960 --> 00:25:30,925
Well, what about that? You know it, don't you?

520
00:25:30,925 --> 00:25:33,160
[On the outskirts of Malinalco, there is a person

521
00:25:33,160 --> 00:25:37,138
who has been carving and sculpting the mountain for almost 30 years,

522
00:25:37,138 --> 00:25:41,150
making the rock his home, his work and his legacy...]

523
00:25:41,150 --> 00:25:44,830
—It is sculpted in the living rock. Here you can see the chisels, look:

524
00:25:44,830 --> 00:25:46,800
Everything I have here is a whole project,

525
00:25:46,800 --> 00:25:50,543
in cultural, spiritual, and environmental preservation.

526
00:25:50,543 --> 00:25:54,301
My project is called Olkeme, because that is the name of this mountain.

527
00:25:54,301 --> 00:25:57,552
And Olkeme means, "He who dresses in movement."

528
00:25:57,552 --> 00:26:01,151
To give something more, be inside the heart of the mountain,

529
00:26:01,151 --> 00:26:04,541
in direct contact with the essence of the Earth.

530
00:26:04,541 --> 00:26:09,717
[He is known as Martin the Builder, guardian of the culture of his ancestors

531
00:26:09,717 --> 00:26:11,460
and an artist driven by a mission:

532
00:26:11,460 --> 00:26:15,751
That whoever visits the place may drink from the knowledge of vision.]

533
00:26:15,751 --> 00:26:17,751
—"The one who dresses in movement"?

534
00:26:18,379 --> 00:26:19,831
—How curious, right?

535
00:26:19,831 --> 00:26:22,486
"Olín" is movement and "kemil" is dress...

536
00:26:23,500 --> 00:26:24,303
"Olkeme".

537
00:26:24,303 --> 00:26:27,790
But, well, it talks about an internal movement, right?

538
00:26:27,790 --> 00:26:31,405
From a movement of the heart: from that which makes you do things, right?

539
00:26:31,405 --> 00:26:33,261
In dynamism, then!

540
00:26:33,261 --> 00:26:35,042
And this has turned out very nice.

541
00:26:35,042 --> 00:26:40,857
It will be useful to future generations, because they are cultural and spiritual references

542
00:26:40,857 --> 00:26:44,880
and we are all in that search, right? ...to be able to understand, to be well...

543
00:26:44,880 --> 00:26:48,348
To reconcile ourselves with the world, or with life or with ourselves.

544
00:26:48,348 --> 00:26:52,166
And why do I do that? Because like many,

545
00:26:52,166 --> 00:26:55,725
I firmly believe that culture is the transversal axis

546
00:26:55,725 --> 00:26:57,240
of the development of human beings.

547
00:26:57,240 --> 00:27:01,201
Now it is seen as folklore, but culture is something very important.

548
00:27:01,201 --> 00:27:04,816
Because as someone said: "It makes

549
00:27:04,816 --> 00:27:07,960
the deepest springs spring from your being."

550
00:27:07,960 --> 00:27:10,963
That's why ethics was born. That's why aesthetics,

551
00:27:10,963 --> 00:27:15,395
poetry, art, science, architecture, medicine, agriculture were born...

552
00:27:15,395 --> 00:27:16,947
For culture!

553
00:27:16,947 --> 00:27:20,135
And now there are people who are university students or professionals,

554
00:27:20,135 --> 00:27:22,863
but they are uneducated. They are ignorant, then!

555
00:27:22,863 --> 00:27:29,259
They know what their career is, their academy; but from there on out, they don't know anything else!

556
00:27:29,259 --> 00:27:30,320
Abysmal ignorance!

557
00:27:30,320 --> 00:27:32,597
In every sense, where they are only looking,

558
00:27:32,597 --> 00:27:36,584
like a mule: "towards the money, towards the money, towards the money..."

559
00:27:36,584 --> 00:27:41,556
And look at the panorama, the beauty, the clouds, the vegetation, the flowers...

560
00:27:41,556 --> 00:27:43,223
The life that embraces us!

561
00:27:43,223 --> 00:27:47,455
You have to fill yourself with life. You have to get infected, you have to become intoxicated with life!

562
00:27:47,455 --> 00:27:50,399
To preserve ancestral memory: Look...

563
00:27:50,399 --> 00:27:54,042
I'm not saying that money is not good or bad...

564
00:27:54,042 --> 00:27:57,976
It is only a means, an instrument

565
00:27:57,976 --> 00:28:03,221
to do certain things, but it is not the goal! That's it: just a means.

566
00:28:03,221 --> 00:28:06,304
Because it comes and goes, it comes back, it goes away, it disappears, it comes back again...

567
00:28:06,304 --> 00:28:08,304
and it's even virtual, if that's how you want to understand it.

568
00:28:08,880 --> 00:28:09,945
An illusion!

569
00:28:09,945 --> 00:28:14,960
But people are wrapped up in that, because they have been told that that is life:

570
00:28:14,960 --> 00:28:18,963
"That is success. That is what gives you value and worth."

571
00:28:18,963 --> 00:28:22,213
Could it be? Will it be true? I do not think so!

572
00:28:22,213 --> 00:28:24,938
Valía will have a person who has human quality.

573
00:28:24,938 --> 00:28:28,120
That one is worth more than a millionaire, who doesn't have that quality,

574
00:28:28,120 --> 00:28:30,319
who maybe with a hug,

575
00:28:30,319 --> 00:28:34,221
makes you feel so good that you say, "Charros, what a joy!"

576
00:28:34,221 --> 00:28:38,548
Or he can even heal you because his embrace is true.

577
00:28:38,548 --> 00:28:42,000
His word is sincere. It's medicine.

578
00:28:42,000 --> 00:28:43,991
How many fucking millionaires,

579
00:28:43,991 --> 00:28:48,000
who don't even know what the money was made for!

580
00:28:48,985 --> 00:28:50,985
Only treasured...

581
00:28:51,000 --> 00:28:53,696
That is why it is so important that the heart flourishes,

582
00:28:53,696 --> 00:28:56,916
that the spirit flourishes... It is very important!

583
00:28:56,916 --> 00:29:01,251
Because later, you disengage from those things and then you share.

584
00:29:01,251 --> 00:29:03,076
—You know it's normal to be called crazy, right?

585
00:29:03,076 --> 00:29:06,955
-Oh yeah. But going crazy has its grip; not everyone arrives.

586
00:29:06,955 --> 00:29:09,872
There are many madmen and many idiots...

587
00:29:09,872 --> 00:29:12,205
But crazy, few.

588
00:29:12,205 --> 00:29:14,709
—The madman is freer than any other; dares to do.

589
00:29:14,709 --> 00:29:17,661
—If that's being crazy, then I am.

590
00:29:17,661 --> 00:29:20,287
So, part of my project is that:

591
00:29:20,287 --> 00:29:24,000
That the people who come here see the archetypes carved in the mountain...

592
00:29:24,000 --> 00:29:27,450
And by going to the heart of the Earth, the idea is that something moves inside you.

593
00:29:27,450 --> 00:29:30,760
If possible, awaken your memory or remember...

594
00:29:30,760 --> 00:29:32,281
Because also, there is a song that says,

595
00:29:32,281 --> 00:29:35,691
"And how can I not sing, If I have everything to be happy?

596
00:29:35,691 --> 00:29:39,418
I have the moon and I have the sun. I have energy and I am warm,

597
00:29:39,418 --> 00:29:43,206
And to the mountain to share Your person, who is here."

598
00:29:43,206 --> 00:29:44,464
-What do you dream?

599
00:29:44,464 --> 00:29:47,286
—What I live. I have learned to be the dream and the dreamer,

600
00:29:47,286 --> 00:29:48,688
And I live this: Life.

601
00:29:48,688 --> 00:29:53,083
That's why I like poetry, because poetry has to be lived.

602
00:29:53,083 --> 00:29:55,009
You live and you dream.

603
00:29:55,009 --> 00:29:57,859
And keep quiet what I say, and dream what I forget.

604
00:29:59,480 --> 00:30:03,530
And it is a saying that is a doing...

605
00:30:03,530 --> 00:30:06,227
And as soon as you say: "It's real," it dissipates.

606
00:30:07,963 --> 00:30:10,917
But here we are, living it.

607
00:30:11,557 --> 00:30:16,259
For moments, for moments, for moments...

608
00:30:16,259 --> 00:30:19,032
Beauty!

609
00:30:19,032 --> 00:30:22,958
Beauty embodied in all things.

610
00:30:22,958 --> 00:30:25,459
In ourself.

611
00:30:26,444 --> 00:30:28,209
Long live life, and long live you!

1
00:00:00,120 --> 00:00:02,904
—Yo no soy un hombre de fe.
Yo, a mí mismo, me considero

2
00:00:02,904 --> 00:00:05,366
un hombre de hechos,
un hombre de acción.

3
00:00:05,366 --> 00:00:09,089
Lo que pienso, lo hago.
Como decimos en México:

4
00:00:09,089 --> 00:00:13,408
"Diciendo y haciendo."
Prefiero la experiencia y no la creencia. 

5
00:00:13,408 --> 00:00:18,173
Hay una diferencia abismal
entre creer y vivirlo: la acción, los hechos. 

6
00:00:18,173 --> 00:00:21,317
No me digas que me quieres, demuéstralo.

7
00:00:21,317 --> 00:00:25,951
 ¡Demuéstralo! Esa es la acción.
Ese es el hecho; y  sin que digas nada,

8
00:00:25,951 --> 00:00:29,209
puedes decir mucho...
Haciendo las cosas.

9
00:00:29,209 --> 00:00:32,960
—Yo te conocí a partir de un vídeo
en el que hablabas de la Impecabilidad.  

10
00:00:32,960 --> 00:00:34,960
¿Me podrías explicar
qué es la Impecabilidad? 

11
00:00:35,042 --> 00:00:40,141
—Ser impecable es ser de una pieza.
Eso significa que como piensas, tienes que vivir.

12
00:00:40,141 --> 00:00:44,543
Como piensas, tienes que comer.
Como piensas, tiene que ser tu vida completa.   

13
00:00:44,543 --> 00:00:45,678
¡Es ser verdadero!

14
00:00:45,678 --> 00:00:49,388
Las pruebas siempre están a la vuelta de la esquina.
Uno dice ser el mejor caminador,

15
00:00:49,388 --> 00:00:51,812
y a la vuelta de la esquina
empiezas a cojear.

16
00:00:51,812 --> 00:00:57,680
Parte de ese concepto llevaba a las personas
a adquirir un rostro verdadero.  

17
00:00:57,680 --> 00:00:59,807
¿Y por qué digo esto? Porque,
¿Qué, no tenemos un rostro?

18
00:00:59,807 --> 00:01:01,663
¡No! Tenemos máscaras.

19
00:01:01,663 --> 00:01:05,111
Máscaras para todo: 
En la casa, con los amigos,

20
00:01:05,111 --> 00:01:08,573
con los hermanos, 
con la novia, con el trabajo...

21
00:01:08,573 --> 00:01:11,339
Pero no damos rostros verdaderos.

22
00:01:11,339 --> 00:01:15,815
Escondemos, guardamos...
Entonces, parte de esa Impecabilidad es eso:

23
00:01:16,307 --> 00:01:19,831
Adquirir un rostro verdadero,
que también significa ser un Tolteca:

24
00:01:20,627 --> 00:01:23,000
El que dialoga
con su propio corazón.  

25
00:01:23,000 --> 00:01:27,659
Yo creo que cualquier conocimiento del mundo 
está a la disposición del ser humano

26
00:01:27,659 --> 00:01:31,326
para su propia trascendencia.
Si no, ¿Qué chiste tiene?

27
00:01:31,326 --> 00:01:32,575
¿Tanto conocimiento?

28
00:01:32,575 --> 00:01:36,000
¿Nada más así, como eruditos 
o como ratas de biblioteca? 

29
00:01:36,000 --> 00:01:37,168
¡Hay que vivirlo!

30
00:01:37,168 --> 00:01:38,418
Hay que vivirlo.

31
00:01:38,418 --> 00:01:40,040
Tú mismo, ahora que viajas tanto, ¿no?  

32
00:01:40,040 --> 00:01:44,289
Podrías leer libros y libros y libros
y enciclopedias de los lugares...  

33
00:01:44,289 --> 00:01:47,661
¡Qué diferente es ir a ellos!
¿No? 

34
00:01:47,661 --> 00:01:50,085
Y vivir y estar con la gente,
el camino, la selva,

35
00:01:50,085 --> 00:01:54,000
el frío, el calor, el alimento...
¡Es otra cosa la experiencia!  

36
00:01:54,000 --> 00:01:56,222
Y la experiencia, pues 
te va a normar el criterio.

37
00:01:56,222 --> 00:01:57,699
Entonces ¡ya no va a ser creencia! 

38
00:01:57,699 --> 00:02:00,000
Ahora va a ser experiencia.

39
00:02:00,000 --> 00:02:02,644
Y eso es parte del conocimiento
antiguo de México,

40
00:02:02,644 --> 00:02:04,644
Tolteca:
La Impecabilidad.

41
00:02:04,876 --> 00:02:06,992
Sé un hombre de experiencia propia.

42
00:02:06,992 --> 00:02:09,985
No te guíes por creencias
ni por cosas de fe. 

43
00:02:09,985 --> 00:02:13,130
¡Tú vívelo! Experiméntalo.
...Y ya después, hablamos.

44
00:02:13,130 --> 00:02:16,913
—La experiencia es mi mayor patrimonio, 
es mi mejor capital. Por eso estoy aquí.

45
00:02:16,913 --> 00:02:19,984
—Porque esa experiencia
se va a ir contigo.

46
00:02:19,984 --> 00:02:23,467
Va a quedar marcada
energéticamente en tu ser. 

47
00:02:23,467 --> 00:02:25,626
Te va a acompañar adonde quiera que vayas. 

48
00:02:25,626 --> 00:02:29,762
Sea que sí o sea que no
existan otras formas de vida,

49
00:02:29,762 --> 00:02:31,126
Te van a acompañar.

50
00:02:31,126 --> 00:02:34,760
Esa es parte,
yo creo, de nuestros elementos...  

51
00:02:34,760 --> 00:02:39,217
¿Verdad? ...en esta vida
para poder ser comprensivos, 

52
00:02:39,217 --> 00:02:40,543
Para poder comprender.

53
00:02:40,543 --> 00:02:42,735
Porque comprender es muy difícil, ¿eh?   

54
00:02:42,735 --> 00:02:47,120
La palabra se oye fácil, "comprender," 
pero llegar a comprender cambia la vida.  

55
00:02:47,120 --> 00:02:49,476
Dijera un poeta mexicano,
que se llamó Nezahualcóyotl,

56
00:02:49,476 --> 00:02:52,650
"Al fin lo comprende mi corazón:

57
00:02:54,000 --> 00:02:58,209
Escucho un canto,
Y veo una flor:

58
00:02:58,209 --> 00:03:01,505
¡Que no se marchiten!
¡Que no se marchiten!"

59
00:03:01,505 --> 00:03:04,224
Comprendió que se iba a morir.

60
00:03:04,224 --> 00:03:06,575
—"¿Acaso en vano venimos a vivir?

61
00:03:06,575 --> 00:03:08,992
¿A brotar sobre la Tierra? 
—Mmm, ¡Ahí está!

62
00:03:08,992 --> 00:03:12,636
Dejemos al menos flores,
Dejemos al menos cantos." 

63
00:03:12,636 --> 00:03:14,107
—¡Así es!
—¿Es de él, no?

64
00:03:14,107 --> 00:03:16,592
—¡Es él! "Dejemos al menos flores
y al menos cantos,"

65
00:03:16,592 --> 00:03:21,176
porque quizás, allá,
en el otro lado, en la región del misterio

66
00:03:21,176 --> 00:03:24,819
se acabarán las flores
y se acabarán los cantos.

67
00:03:24,819 --> 00:03:26,388
Pero aquí,
en la Tierra...

68
00:03:26,388 --> 00:03:27,194
¡Nadie!

69
00:03:27,487 --> 00:03:29,918
Nadie puede acabar
con las flores y con los cantos.

70
00:03:30,177 --> 00:03:33,120
—¡Al fin comprendí!

71
00:03:34,724 --> 00:03:36,000
No sabía que era por eso.

72
00:03:36,000 --> 00:03:39,023
—¿Ya ves? ¿Ya viste por qué?
La comprensión es difícil, 

73
00:03:39,560 --> 00:03:42,849
pero cuando lo comprendes,
se abre algo en tu corazón,  

74
00:03:42,849 --> 00:03:45,880
en tu mente y entonces,
empieza a llegar algo

75
00:03:45,880 --> 00:03:48,292
que se llama:
Conciencia. 

76
00:03:48,292 --> 00:03:50,065
¡Está de moda!
Todo el mundo habla de ella,

77
00:03:50,065 --> 00:03:51,930
¡Y nadie sabe qué es!

78
00:03:52,851 --> 00:03:55,563
Todo el mundo hacen
cursos de "Conciencia,"

79
00:03:55,563 --> 00:03:58,897
cursos de no sé qué, y están...
Discúlpeme ¡Siguen igual!

80
00:03:58,897 --> 00:04:01,413
Cada vez hay más "conciencia," y el mundo,
¡No lo veo que cambie!

81
00:04:01,413 --> 00:04:02,815
¡Y cada vez hay más "conciencia"!

82
00:04:02,815 --> 00:04:04,894
—Con todo el "mindfulness" que hay, ¿no? ...

83
00:04:04,894 --> 00:04:08,493
—Sí, sí...Terapeutas, retiros...
Gente con diploma

84
00:04:08,493 --> 00:04:09,932
que ya tiene "conciencia".

85
00:04:09,932 --> 00:04:13,140
—O sea, "un diploma acredita tu conciencia."
—Sí, ¿no? "Ya eres un chamán."

86
00:04:13,140 --> 00:04:15,519
—Pagando.
—¡Sí, claro! 

87
00:04:15,519 --> 00:04:17,080
Está bien indagar,
está bien buscar

88
00:04:17,080 --> 00:04:20,797
pero ahí es donde entra la Impecabilidad:
hay que hacerlo auténtico.

89
00:04:20,797 --> 00:04:22,797
Hay que hacerlo verdadero.

90
00:04:22,880 --> 00:04:25,319
Sino, ¡no sirve!
No pasa de ser una moda,

91
00:04:25,319 --> 00:04:29,600
No pasa de ser una práctica que,
por la euforia del momento...  

92
00:04:29,600 --> 00:04:30,904
Y después, ¡se olvida!  

93
00:04:30,904 --> 00:04:34,920
Porque para andar dentro de esos caminos,
también se requiere cierta disciplina.

94
00:04:34,920 --> 00:04:40,011
¿No? Cierta garra, cierto esfuerzo...
En todos los aspectos.

95
00:04:40,011 --> 00:04:42,932
—Conocí a un abuelo en Colombia
que me decía:  

96
00:04:42,932 --> 00:04:45,925
"No tienes más opción
que ser lo que caminas."

97
00:04:45,925 --> 00:04:48,880
—¿Y se escucha fácil, verdad?
—¡Uf, es dificilísimo!  

98
00:04:48,880 --> 00:04:51,502
—Pero punto número uno:
Tienes que reconocerlo.

99
00:04:51,502 --> 00:04:53,242
—Por lo menos, verlo.
—Eso que eres que caminas...

100
00:04:53,242 --> 00:04:55,254
O por lo menos,
¡eso que crees que eres!  

101
00:04:56,759 --> 00:04:58,308
—Que luego cambia
y muta con el tiempo.

102
00:04:58,308 --> 00:04:59,179
—¡Claro, por eso te digo! 

103
00:04:59,179 --> 00:05:02,182
A veces no somos
ni lo que creíamos que éramos.

104
00:05:02,599 --> 00:05:06,160
Entonces, el reconocimiento, ¿no?
El día a día: ¡Hay que vivir!  

105
00:05:06,160 --> 00:05:09,453
Y cada segundo cuenta,
hay que vivirlo. ¡Nos vamos a ir!  

106
00:05:09,453 --> 00:05:12,560
Hay que dejar algo,
hay que compartir. 

107
00:05:12,560 --> 00:05:17,259
Porque, ¿qué más podemos dejar?
Pues, nuestro conocimiento, nuestra energía...

108
00:05:17,259 --> 00:05:18,960
Brecha,
para otros que vienen atrás. 

109
00:05:18,960 --> 00:05:24,000
La vida, como vida,
contiene un principio de reciprocidad.

110
00:05:24,000 --> 00:05:25,560
Uno tiene que contribuir también.  

111
00:05:25,560 --> 00:05:28,704
Es una forma de honrarla.
Ella nos honra,

112
00:05:28,704 --> 00:05:30,977
Dándonos todo...
Y nosotros ¿Qué le damos?   

113
00:05:30,977 --> 00:05:32,522
¡Pura caca!

114
00:05:33,052 --> 00:05:34,522
Todos los días.

115
00:05:34,522 --> 00:05:37,342
Osea, se oye apestoso y se oye feo,
y a lo mejor, hasta grotesco lo que digo

116
00:05:37,342 --> 00:05:39,880
Pero ¡Es la verdad!

117
00:05:39,880 --> 00:05:42,666
¡Es la verdad! Y quien diga que no hace caca,
pues no es humano.

118
00:05:42,666 --> 00:05:44,560
—Si fuera caca de la buena...
—¿Verdad?  

119
00:05:44,560 --> 00:05:47,456
¿Qué estamos haciendo?
¿Qué somos pues, entonces?   

120
00:05:47,456 --> 00:05:49,229
¿Una plaga?

121
00:05:49,229 --> 00:05:50,575
¿Un manojo de carne y huesos?

122
00:05:51,131 --> 00:05:52,760
¡No, seguramente no! 

123
00:05:52,760 --> 00:05:56,746
Ya es tiempo de sacudirse,
de desempolvarse ciertas ideas,

124
00:05:56,746 --> 00:06:00,686
ciertos esquemas que han sido impuestos 
durante cientos de años, 

125
00:06:00,686 --> 00:06:02,376
que no nos conducen a nada.

126
00:06:02,376 --> 00:06:05,619
No estoy invitando a una revolución, 
o a una guerra...

127
00:06:05,619 --> 00:06:07,874
Pero, a lo mejor sí, a una guerra.
Pero a una guerra interna.

128
00:06:08,404 --> 00:06:09,874
A una guerra interior.
¿Verdad?  

129
00:06:09,920 --> 00:06:12,593
Que es la más difícil,
la más difícil de librar.

130
00:06:12,593 --> 00:06:14,593
Por eso aquí se llamó,
acertadamente,  

131
00:06:14,593 --> 00:06:18,000
la Guerra Florida:
La lucha contigo mismo.

132
00:06:18,000 --> 00:06:21,278
El vencimiento de tu ego,
o de tu enemigo que llevas dentro.

133
00:06:21,278 --> 00:06:25,364
Para que, una vez que logres vencer
esa parte interna,

134
00:06:25,591 --> 00:06:29,486
Tu corazón florezca;
tu rostro se haga verdadero.

135
00:06:29,486 --> 00:06:31,530
¡Venciste la Guerra Florida!

136
00:06:31,530 --> 00:06:33,682
Y qué maravilla pues comprender

137
00:06:33,682 --> 00:06:36,864
que, como en un engranaje
de un reloj,

138
00:06:36,864 --> 00:06:39,463
una hormiga, un animal,
una planta, un ser humano

139
00:06:39,463 --> 00:06:41,744
forman parte de ese engranaje.

140
00:06:41,744 --> 00:06:45,335
Por lo tanto, tiene un propósito,
tiene una función...

141
00:06:45,335 --> 00:06:49,265
Hasta como el colibrí, ahorita, que vino
a confirmarnos, a reafirmarnos

142
00:06:49,265 --> 00:06:51,251
lo que íbamos a empezar
ahorita a platicar ¿no? 

143
00:06:51,251 --> 00:06:53,042
—¿Qué has aprendido
en el Camino del Guerrero?

144
00:06:53,042 --> 00:06:54,960
—A ser yo a ser yo.
A ser yo, tal cual.  

145
00:06:54,960 --> 00:06:59,418
Física, mental, espiritualmente, ¿no?
Y me acepto y me quiero tal como soy:

146
00:06:59,418 --> 00:07:01,880
chaparrito, pelo largo, moreno...  

147
00:07:01,880 --> 00:07:05,818
Y me gusta, aparte, la palabra "florida".
Y esto lo aprendí también en el camino,

148
00:07:06,538 --> 00:07:08,576
Porque la palabra es sagrada.

149
00:07:08,576 --> 00:07:11,281
—Este mismo abuelo
del que te hablaba antes, me decía:

150
00:07:11,281 --> 00:07:14,501
"Cuida tu palabra,
que tu palabra te cuidará." 

151
00:07:14,501 --> 00:07:16,898
—Pues, sí. Porque sino,
por eso digo, te haces el lío.

152
00:07:16,898 --> 00:07:20,421
Haces una ofensa,
pues va a venir después otra.

153
00:07:20,421 --> 00:07:23,737
Cuidas tu palabra,
pues al contrario, ¿no?

154
00:07:23,737 --> 00:07:27,306
—Y en este camino de la Impecabilidad,
cuando erramos, ¿Qué sucede ahí?   

155
00:07:27,306 --> 00:07:29,306
—Hay que volverlo a intentar porque, mira:

156
00:07:29,306 --> 00:07:32,989
Hay que aprender a caminar
por encima de triunfos y derrotas.

157
00:07:32,989 --> 00:07:36,668
Una de las premisas que
nos han enseñado, o esquemas,  

158
00:07:36,668 --> 00:07:39,198
es que "Todo es un éxito
o todo es un fracaso."

159
00:07:39,198 --> 00:07:41,495
"Todo es una bendición o todo es una maldición."

160
00:07:41,495 --> 00:07:43,200
¡Eso es una tontería!  

161
00:07:43,200 --> 00:07:47,424
Porque al andar en el camino de la vida,
que está lleno de redes y de agujeros,

162
00:07:47,424 --> 00:07:49,424
seguramente vas a caer en algunos.

163
00:07:49,886 --> 00:07:54,952
Pero la grandeza es levantarse. 
No es no caer, sino levantarse.

164
00:07:54,952 --> 00:07:58,224
Entonces, hay que aprender
a caminar por este mundo

165
00:07:58,224 --> 00:08:00,224
por encima de triunfos y derrotas. 

166
00:08:00,224 --> 00:08:03,818
Porque todo en la vida 
ni es un triunfo ni es una derrota,

167
00:08:03,818 --> 00:08:05,788
Ni es una maldición,
ni es una bendición.  

168
00:08:05,788 --> 00:08:07,860
Realmente, todo es un desafío.

169
00:08:07,860 --> 00:08:10,133
En la misma moto que tú andas, ¿no?  

170
00:08:10,133 --> 00:08:14,187
Derrapas, te caes...
Pues ¡te levantas y sigues! ¿No?

171
00:08:14,187 --> 00:08:16,700
No me retrio, sigo.
¿No? Igual, así es la vida.

172
00:08:16,700 --> 00:08:19,541
En la vida no puede haber una línea de felicidad.  

173
00:08:19,541 --> 00:08:23,173
Porque esa línea de felicidad,
para mí, es hasta aburrida.

174
00:08:23,173 --> 00:08:24,840
¡Es aburrida!
Es cotidiano.

175
00:08:24,840 --> 00:08:26,694
¡Es de hábitos!
¡No, no puede ser!

176
00:08:26,694 --> 00:08:29,376
El mundo es cambiante,
y hay que acoplarse.

177
00:08:29,376 --> 00:08:31,376
Hoy estás aquí;
mañana no vas a estar. 

178
00:08:31,619 --> 00:08:34,751
Hoy vas a estar contento,
hoy te salió bien el guiso; mañana no.  

179
00:08:34,751 --> 00:08:36,560
Los proyectos así son también, ¿no? 

180
00:08:36,560 --> 00:08:40,089
A veces trabajas más, a veces trabajas...
No puede haber una línea.

181
00:08:40,089 --> 00:08:42,089
Sería aburridísimo.

182
00:08:42,173 --> 00:08:46,994
—Parece que hay cierto tabú
respecto al estar triste o estar mal.

183
00:08:46,994 --> 00:08:51,722
Como que la sociedad premia al estar bien: 
"¡Que queda lindo estar bien!",

184
00:08:51,722 --> 00:08:55,189
Pero condenando bastante el estar mal:
"¡Uy! ¿Por qué estará mal?"

185
00:08:55,189 --> 00:08:58,485
—Pero, aún el que está aparentemente alegre, no está bien.  

186
00:08:58,485 --> 00:09:01,364
Porque es una máscara,
porque por dentro están llorando.

187
00:09:01,364 --> 00:09:04,234
Por dentro están tristes...
¡Somos humanos!

188
00:09:04,234 --> 00:09:09,273
Sentimos frío, sentimos calor,
sentimos alegría, tenemos anhelos...

189
00:09:09,273 --> 00:09:12,994
No podemos mentir;
no podemos decir que no.

190
00:09:12,994 --> 00:09:14,585
Yo, por ejemplo, me saludan,
me dicen, "¿Cómo estás?"  

191
00:09:14,585 --> 00:09:16,560
"Pues contento,"
Porque trato de estar contento.

192
00:09:16,560 --> 00:09:18,000
A pesar de que pase lo que pase.

193
00:09:18,000 --> 00:09:21,308
Pero no me gusta quejarme.
Eso es diferente, ¿no?

194
00:09:21,308 --> 00:09:23,695
"Ay, es que me pasa esto, me pasa aquello,"
y empiezo a maldecir...

195
00:09:23,695 --> 00:09:25,826
¡No! Pues se va a resolver
de alguna manera.

196
00:09:25,826 --> 00:09:28,440
Lo único que no se puede resolver
es la muerte; y eso ¿quién sabe?  

197
00:09:28,440 --> 00:09:30,477
A lo mejor es una alternativa...

198
00:09:30,477 --> 00:09:31,079
—y Hacienda.

199
00:09:31,079 --> 00:09:32,488
—Ah sí, claro.

200
00:09:32,488 --> 00:09:34,042
—Lo decía Groucho Marx:

201
00:09:34,042 --> 00:09:37,140
"Lo único que no tiene solución en la vida
es la muerte y Hacienda."

202
00:09:37,140 --> 00:09:41,400
—Pero, ¡algunos somos 
insurgentes y no pagamos Hacienda!

203
00:09:41,400 --> 00:09:43,761
Entonces, hay que vivir
como sea que venga la vida, ¿no?

204
00:09:43,761 --> 00:09:48,800
Alegre, triste... Porque pues,
hay de todo, ¿no?  

205
00:09:48,800 --> 00:09:52,470
¡Hay de todo, y así es!
Y eso es lo que la hace ser rica. 

206
00:09:52,470 --> 00:09:54,213
La experiencia es rica por eso.

207
00:09:54,213 --> 00:09:55,235
—¿Qué es para ti la riqueza?

208
00:09:55,235 --> 00:09:57,796
—Pues, la riqueza para mí
es el cúmulo de experiencias.

209
00:09:57,796 --> 00:10:00,334
El conocimiento,
el nivel de entendimiento.  

210
00:10:00,334 --> 00:10:04,948
De verdad, si yo muriera y volviera a 
nacer, tomaba yo el mismo camino.

211
00:10:04,948 --> 00:10:07,911
Me ha encantado
el camino del Guerrero,

212
00:10:07,911 --> 00:10:09,911
el camino del Conocimiento,
el camino de mi cultura.

213
00:10:10,449 --> 00:10:12,542
Entonces, la riqueza para mí es eso, ¿no?

214
00:10:12,542 --> 00:10:15,914
El poder entender, el poder
comprender, el poder saber.

215
00:10:15,914 --> 00:10:19,543
Porque hay cosas que
la riqueza material no puede comprar,  

216
00:10:19,543 --> 00:10:23,360
y una de ellas es la salud:
la salud mental, la salud espiritual.  

217
00:10:23,360 --> 00:10:28,213
Hay gente que está en agujeros espirituales
o en miserias espirituales...

218
00:10:28,895 --> 00:10:30,630
No tan solo económicas. 

219
00:10:30,630 --> 00:10:33,316
Pero si tú eres rico espiritualmente,

220
00:10:33,316 --> 00:10:35,241
tú vas a ser rico económicamente,
en automático,

221
00:10:35,241 --> 00:10:38,734
porque vas a tener el impulso
y el empuje para hacer las cosas,

222
00:10:38,734 --> 00:10:41,625
y de una u otra manera,
lo vas a resolver.   

223
00:10:41,625 --> 00:10:42,835
Hay un canto que dice:

224
00:10:42,835 --> 00:10:45,934
"El pájaro cada día
busca de nuevo su nido." 

225
00:10:45,934 --> 00:10:50,396
¿De qué te preocupas, mi hermano?

226
00:10:50,396 --> 00:10:54,000
—...Si ¡cada día el pájaro tiene
que buscar dónde dormir, hermano!

227
00:10:55,578 --> 00:10:57,512
Cuando encuentras a tu enemigo,  

228
00:10:57,512 --> 00:11:00,189
que según te entendí,
eres tú mismo,  

229
00:11:00,189 --> 00:11:01,126
¿Qué haces?

230
00:11:01,126 --> 00:11:04,840
—Primero hay que conocerlo,
hay que identificarlo.  

231
00:11:04,840 --> 00:11:07,762
Yo empiezo a pensar, ¿no?
Y en ese pensar,

232
00:11:07,762 --> 00:11:10,680
veo qué emoción
me produce ese pensamiento,   

233
00:11:10,680 --> 00:11:13,245
o qué sentimiento
me produce ese pensamiento...

234
00:11:13,245 --> 00:11:15,245
¿Cómo se pone mi cuerpo?
¿Cómo late mi corazón?

235
00:11:15,245 --> 00:11:16,200
¿O mi hígado, no?

236
00:11:16,200 --> 00:11:18,891
Y entonces, ahí me doy cuenta,
me voy dando cuenta 

237
00:11:18,891 --> 00:11:21,240
de las cosas que me afectan
o que no me afectan, 

238
00:11:21,240 --> 00:11:23,256
o hasta de mis propios vicios:

239
00:11:23,256 --> 00:11:25,256
¿Qué quiero más?
¿Qué quiero menos?

240
00:11:25,256 --> 00:11:27,120
¿Qué anhelo más?
¿Qué anhelo menos?

241
00:11:27,120 --> 00:11:30,000
En esa sencillez, yo empecé
a darme cuenta

242
00:11:30,000 --> 00:11:34,000
cuáles eran mis fortalezas,
cuáles eran mis debilidades...  

243
00:11:34,000 --> 00:11:37,506
Pero real, real, real, real... Y de la forma
más sencilla se puede.

244
00:11:37,506 --> 00:11:39,400
Pero hay que ser honesto.  

245
00:11:39,400 --> 00:11:42,000
¡Hay que ser bien honesto!
Y generalmente no somos honestos.

246
00:11:42,000 --> 00:11:43,262
Nos engañamos muy fácil,

247
00:11:43,262 --> 00:11:46,254
o le damos una justificante a las cosas.

248
00:11:46,254 --> 00:11:49,316
Se tiene uno que desnudar completamente 
para verse a sí mismo.

249
00:11:49,316 --> 00:11:52,167
Así literalmente, como 
desnudo en un espejo

250
00:11:52,167 --> 00:11:56,310
para ver cómo eres,
qué tienes... Qué eres.

251
00:11:56,310 --> 00:12:00,288
Yo digo, no hay un método
para todos ¡Es personal! 

252
00:12:00,288 --> 00:12:01,738
¡Es personalísimo!

253
00:12:01,738 --> 00:12:04,799
Como los descubrimientos espirituales,
son personalísimos.

254
00:12:04,799 --> 00:12:06,814
Los llamados son personalísimos.

255
00:12:06,814 --> 00:12:10,334
Entonces, ¿el método?
Pues yo digo, ¡Invéntatelo tú mismo!

256
00:12:10,334 --> 00:12:12,227
Tú eres el único que sabe cómo estás.

257
00:12:12,227 --> 00:12:15,651
Ni el mejor terapeuta te va a dar la solución.

258
00:12:15,651 --> 00:12:18,000
Quizás te dará un camino,
pero tú caminas el camino.

259
00:12:18,000 --> 00:12:22,516
Y así, te vas dando cuenta que a lo mejor,
de repente tienes una posibilidad,

260
00:12:22,516 --> 00:12:24,000
un talento...

261
00:12:24,000 --> 00:12:26,229
¡O hasta una virtud!

262
00:12:26,229 --> 00:12:28,703
Pero después viene la otra parte,
que es parte de la lucha:

263
00:12:28,703 --> 00:12:30,370
¡Ahora, ejércela!

264
00:12:30,370 --> 00:12:32,903
¡Ahora ejércela!
¡No lo dudes!

265
00:12:32,903 --> 00:12:36,426
Estamos llenos de dudas;
estamos llenos de miedos.

266
00:12:36,426 --> 00:12:38,704
Porque desde niños,
los adquirimos.

267
00:12:38,704 --> 00:12:42,000
Nacemos seguramente libres,
sin miedos y sin dudas.

268
00:12:42,000 --> 00:12:49,003
Pero la educación de todo el derredor
te va formando.

269
00:12:49,003 --> 00:12:51,640
Y cuando menos ves,
ya estás igual que todos:

270
00:12:51,640 --> 00:12:54,401
Adoleces de todo,
quieres lo que todos,

271
00:12:54,401 --> 00:12:57,292
Piensas lo que todos,
vistes lo que todos, y comes lo que todos.

272
00:12:57,583 --> 00:13:00,000
Pues yo digo,
¡Eso se llama colonización!

273
00:13:00,000 --> 00:13:02,000
—Vigente hoy día, ¿eh?
—Vigente hoy día.   

274
00:13:02,000 --> 00:13:05,160
Hay que romper esas cosas porque,
¿Qué está en juego?

275
00:13:05,160 --> 00:13:07,679
¡Pues, nuestra propia vida
está en juego!

276
00:13:07,679 --> 00:13:10,615
Y de verdad que es difícil
comprenderlo.

277
00:13:10,615 --> 00:13:13,115
Se entiende, a lo mejor, 
mentalmente:

278
00:13:13,172 --> 00:13:15,472
"Ah, es que tú nada más
vas a pasar aquí temporalmente",

279
00:13:15,472 --> 00:13:17,101
"Ah no, osea sí...
nos vamos a morir todos",  

280
00:13:17,101 --> 00:13:18,622
"Ah, es verdad:
Nos vamos a morir todos"   

281
00:13:18,622 --> 00:13:22,099
¿Pero ya lo comprendiste?
¿Ya lo entendiste, verdaderamente? 

282
00:13:22,099 --> 00:13:26,026
¡Entonces, ponte a hacerlo ya!
Porque mañana puede no llegar.

283
00:13:26,026 --> 00:13:27,167
—Pero, es que comprender eso...

284
00:13:27,167 --> 00:13:29,533
—Por eso te digo:
La comprensión, ¿verdad que es difícil?

285
00:13:29,533 --> 00:13:30,670
¿No es tan simple? 

286
00:13:30,670 --> 00:13:33,541
Hay que mover teclados interiores,

287
00:13:33,541 --> 00:13:37,784
ciertas fibras en nuestro interior,
para que algo se mueva...

288
00:13:37,784 --> 00:13:39,895
Y entonces digas,
"Sí, tienes razón."

289
00:13:39,895 --> 00:13:42,557
—Es difícil comprender algo y
permanecer impasible.

290
00:13:42,557 --> 00:13:43,496
—No se puede.  

291
00:13:43,496 --> 00:13:46,489
Por eso te digo: Eso te lleva la conciencia,
a la comprensión.

292
00:13:46,489 --> 00:13:48,718
Y si llega la conciencia a tu vida, 
tengo certeza

293
00:13:48,718 --> 00:13:50,718
que cambia de un día para otro.   

294
00:13:50,840 --> 00:13:53,501
No puedes quedarte estático:
Ya te diste cuenta,

295
00:13:53,501 --> 00:13:55,698
y entonces dices:
"¡El tiempo sí cuenta!

296
00:13:55,698 --> 00:13:58,683
¡Sí tiene que ver el tiempo!
¡No, apúrate que ya nos queda poco!"

297
00:13:58,683 --> 00:14:01,382
Porque eternos,
así, con en esta forma,   

298
00:14:01,382 --> 00:14:03,382
No vamos a serlo.

299
00:14:03,920 --> 00:14:06,155
Nos vamos a tener que ir.

300
00:14:06,698 --> 00:14:10,043
Tarde que temprano, 
nos vamos a tener que ir.

301
00:14:10,043 --> 00:14:14,051
Entonces...
Ya no hay que perder tiempo.

302
00:14:14,793 --> 00:14:16,363
—¿Te da miedo el tener que irte?  

303
00:14:16,363 --> 00:14:17,758
—No.

304
00:14:17,758 --> 00:14:19,758
No, no me da miedo.
No tengo miedo.

305
00:14:20,220 --> 00:14:23,378
Podría tener incertidumbre...
Un poquito, nada más,

306
00:14:23,378 --> 00:14:25,793
de qué puede haber del otro lado,
o qué sigue... 

307
00:14:25,793 --> 00:14:27,280
Pero miedo no.

308
00:14:27,280 --> 00:14:31,192
Miedo no. Es más, nosotros en México
tenemos un dicho que dice así:

309
00:14:31,192 --> 00:14:34,334
"Si me he de morir mañana,
que me muera de una vez."  

310
00:14:34,334 --> 00:14:38,218
Prepararse para vivir
es prepararse para morir.

311
00:14:38,218 --> 00:14:40,218
Parece paradójico, ¿verdad?

312
00:14:40,710 --> 00:14:41,666
Pero lo es.

313
00:14:41,666 --> 00:14:43,940
¡Lo es!
Es algo que va de la mano.

314
00:14:43,940 --> 00:14:44,876
—¿Es todo dual?

315
00:14:44,876 --> 00:14:46,572
—En su mayoría sí.  

316
00:14:46,572 --> 00:14:49,565
Pero esa dualidad
tiene una unidad también.

317
00:14:49,565 --> 00:14:51,725
Nosotros mismos:
tienes dos manos,

318
00:14:51,725 --> 00:14:53,725
dos pies, dos hemisferios,
dos ojos...

319
00:14:53,725 --> 00:14:55,982
dos salidas
de la nariz,  

320
00:14:56,120 --> 00:14:58,504
dos orejas...
Pero eres uno.

321
00:14:58,504 --> 00:15:02,084
La dualidad, yo pienso que 
contiene una complejidad.

322
00:15:02,084 --> 00:15:04,680
Y esa complejidad, pues 
también es una dualidad.

323
00:15:04,680 --> 00:15:06,971
Y es una pluralidad, ¿no?

324
00:15:06,971 --> 00:15:10,040
Nada más que todo nos lo enseñan
estricto, tajante,

325
00:15:10,040 --> 00:15:13,963
sin cromos, sin medios:
"O es blanco, o es negro."

326
00:15:13,963 --> 00:15:17,297
Pero entre el blanco y el negro,
hay una variedad de cromos,  

327
00:15:17,297 --> 00:15:20,175
de intensidades, ¿no?
Eso es lo que no se ha entendido.

328
00:15:20,175 --> 00:15:23,357
Y es, también, lo que han malentendido
a la cultura mexicana,

329
00:15:23,357 --> 00:15:25,918
porque la mexicana habla mucho 
de una dualidad.

330
00:15:25,918 --> 00:15:29,479
Nosotros no tenemos problema
para entender la pluralidad de las cosas,   

331
00:15:29,479 --> 00:15:33,179
porque el Espíritu mismo
es una diversidad de cosas.

332
00:15:33,179 --> 00:15:35,251
Es una pluralidad increíble.

333
00:15:35,251 --> 00:15:41,055
Y gracias a esa pluralidad,   
existe el mundo con todas sus diversidades.

334
00:15:41,055 --> 00:15:44,255
No solamente de geografías,
sino de seres humanos.   

335
00:15:44,255 --> 00:15:46,255
La cosmovisión de México
habla de todo eso,

336
00:15:46,377 --> 00:15:49,408
de un principio, sí,
un principio abstracto,

337
00:15:49,408 --> 00:15:54,196
un principio invisible, un principio impalpable,
una chispa de luz.  

338
00:15:54,196 --> 00:15:56,137
En México se llama Moyocoyani

339
00:15:56,137 --> 00:15:59,842
y significa "El que a sí mismo se inventa y a sí mismo se transforma."  

340
00:16:00,418 --> 00:16:05,510
Y esa fuerza impersonal, por su propia 
virtud o su propia potencia, se desdobló.  

341
00:16:05,510 --> 00:16:08,797
Y se hizo un ser andrógino,
y nace Ometéotl.   

342
00:16:08,797 --> 00:16:11,002
Y el andrógino se divide en dos,

343
00:16:11,002 --> 00:16:12,964
y nace el hombre y la mujer:
Lo dual.

344
00:16:12,964 --> 00:16:18,000
Y luego, lo dual crea cuatro hijos, ¿verdad?
Y esos cuatro hijos crean otros cuatro.

345
00:16:18,000 --> 00:16:22,950
Y así se empieza, de una unidad,
a ser una dualidad y luego una pluralidad...

346
00:16:22,950 --> 00:16:24,950
Pero en la totalidad del espacio.   

347
00:16:25,640 --> 00:16:29,380
De tal manera que la creación de la vida,
desde el ángulo mexicano,

348
00:16:29,380 --> 00:16:31,380
no es creado a través de un elemento, 

349
00:16:31,380 --> 00:16:34,363
sino es creado
a través de muchísimos conjugados...   

350
00:16:34,363 --> 00:16:37,920
Y luego, todos esos elementos
se pueden mezclar uno con otro,

351
00:16:37,920 --> 00:16:40,940
y crean algo nuevo.
Y muchas esencias...   

352
00:16:40,940 --> 00:16:42,940
Pero que todas vienen
de un principio.

353
00:16:43,440 --> 00:16:46,062
Por eso se habla que todo es sagrado
y todo es divino, 

354
00:16:46,062 --> 00:16:50,828
Porque ese principio divino plural
se desdobló en todas las cosas. 

355
00:16:50,828 --> 00:16:54,501
Y uno, como individuo,
le tiene uno que regresar un poquito   

356
00:16:54,501 --> 00:16:56,917
de esa honra y de esa energía,
de esa esencia,

357
00:16:56,917 --> 00:16:59,418
porque está tan dividido 
que puede de morir.   

358
00:16:59,418 --> 00:17:03,653
Porque la esencia divina plural
